subject: maths
question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is 55.44 { m}² , which is two-thirds of its total surface area. Find the volume of the cylinder correct to two decimal places ({use } pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CSA = (2/3) of TSA ⇒ TSA = (3/2) × 55.44 = 83.16

TSA − CSA = 2πr² ⇒ 83.16 − 55.44 = 27.72

2πr² = 27.72 ⇒ r = 2.1 m

CSA = 2πrh ⇒ 55.44 = 2π × 2.1 × h ⇒ h = 4.2 m

Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × (2.1)² × 4.2 = 58.21

**∴ Answer = 58.21 m³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved Surface Area = 55.44 m², CSA = (2/3) of TSA

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

CSA = 2πrh, TSA = 2πr(h + r), Volume = πr²h

**Calculation:**

⇒ TSA = (3/2) × 55.44 = 83.16

⇒ 2πr(h + r) − 2πrh = 27.72

⇒ 2πr² = 27.72

⇒ r² = 27.72 ÷ (2π) = 27.72 ÷ (44/7) = 4.41

⇒ r = 2.1 m

⇒ 55.44 = 2πrh

⇒ 55.44 = (44/7) × 2.1 × h

⇒ h = 4.2 m

⇒ Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × 4.41 × 4.2

⇒ Volume = 58.21 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 58.21 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Surface Relation

TSA = CSA + 2πr², useful when relation between CSA and TSA is given.

Volume Formula

Volume = πr²h

Shortcut Insight

When CSA is fraction of TSA, directly isolate r using difference.
